build: bschema-draw-jev3-slice (data/jev3.py + scripts/jev3_build.py: HUMAN-labelled TRAIN-split rows for judge_hard, adequacy, policy, ambiguous, temporal_numeric, long_policy; role slice)
role: held-out selection slice (checkpoint selection only; never trained on)
location: ssdm-data/m2/build/bschema-draw-jev3-slice/ (outside git; deterministic, a rerun reproduces it)
ids_sha256_rule: sha256 of the sorted record ids, newline-joined (no trailing newline)
schema: ssdm-train-v0, one question per row (qid 'q'), JevBench request shape; jev1 row layout (aug.jev1.family8; aug.jev1.prov = per-row dataset / revision / licence / train split / row key)
loader_contract: option keys are NOT re-sorted (seeded per-row shuffle = presented order); no state text (normalised) is shared by any two rows of train + slice

slice_disjoint.rule: slice vs train: 0 shared ids, source items, groups, content hashes, normalised states

excludes_cohort: m2-dev-cohort-v2 be6efe2b... and m2-dev-cohort-v3 498efa61..., Index DEV/TEST rows, JevBench public items (eval-only), every jev1 source item of HelpSteer2 / HS2-preference / Aegis2, MATH test problems (PRM800K)
